text.text_excerpt: Had my first Mac & Moon macaroons today OMG SO GOOD!!!!!! I got them inside the Auction House Market on White Linen Night. I got 5 (wish I had gotten more!) but they were all FANTASTIC!!!! I HIGHLY recommend the birthday cake, salted caramel, espresso, those were my ultimate fav! Completely vegan. Amazing. UPDATE: Kristina and her team and Mac & Moon are absolutely amazing. They are constantly rotating cool new tasty flavors, my new favorite is s'mores!! The rolled ice cream is (completely vegan) TO DIE FOR. I love getting crushed Oreos in it. Their shop inside Auction House Market is clean, bright, fun, and fancy. You HAVE TO TRY THEM. This is a MUST STOP for any and everyone visiting NOLA.

I was so excited for an all vegan (rolled!) ice cream and macaroon place. And in such a beautiful setting. I ordered 5 macaroons and the strawberry ice cream, forgetting that I don't really have a sweet tooth, but I wanted to try everything. It was sweet. Very sweet. I ate about one of the rolls of ice cream (not sure what the flavouring is, to be honest - they used some liquid in a squeeze bottle to turn the ice cream base strawberry and I think that had to be sugar syrup) and a bite out of each macaroon over the week (my partner ate the rest). I think it's a brilliant spot to have on the vegan menu here in NOLA, but next time I'll remember that maybe only one macaroon or sharing the ice...

We stopped by tonight after dinner (3/14). This is an all vegan dessert place in a food hall. On this occasion we were not able to try the rolled ice cream. I don't remember if the reason was mentioned. I settled for macaroons, 10 for $22. My friend got the matcha tea with almond milk. Below is my review of the items I tried. -Matcha tea. It is refreshing alongside the macaroons. Note that it is on the floral side so it may not be for everyone. -Champagne macaroon. It has the lightest floral hint to it. -Espresso macaroon.
